about: The introitus of the formulary “Dedication of the Archbasilica of the Most Holy Savior” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: This place is awe-inspiring: here is the house of God, and the gate of heaven; and it will be called the palace of God. How beloved are Your dwellings, O Lord of hosts! My soul longs and faints for the courts of the Lord. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.
